aspect: The consulate closes and the document expires anyway
description: Severed relations mean no renewal. The document runs out on schedule regardless, and on that date the person's legal existence abroad begins to unwind.
energy_note: A countdown you cannot stop or appeal.

aspect: Renewing requires dealing with the state you fled
description: For a political refugee this is a direct contradiction: legal existence abroad requires approaching the authority the asylum claim is based on fearing.
energy_note: Ask the people you fled for permission to exist.

description: Work permit, driving licence, bank account, tenancy, health cover and marriage registration all key off the document. One expiry cascades through an entire life within months.

aspect: SCENARIO - the expired passport in Tbilisi
description: It ran out in March. The consulate is not issuing. His lease renewal needs a valid document, his employer's payroll system has flagged it, and the bank has restricted the account. He has not committed any act; a date passed.
